game.name: Pac-Man
game.desc: Navigate mazes eating dots while avoiding ghosts. One of the most iconic arcade games ever made, Pac-Man became a cultural phenomenon & spawned numerous sequels.

game.name: Galaga
game.desc: A fixed shooter where the player controls a spaceship at the bottom of the screen, shooting at waves of alien insects.

game.name: Donkey Kong
game.desc: Jump over barrels and climb ladders to rescue the damsel from the giant ape. The game that introduced Mario to the world.

game.name: Asteroids
game.desc: Pilot a spaceship through an asteroid field, shooting rocks that break into smaller pieces. A classic vector graphics arcade game.

game.name: Street Fighter II
game.desc: Choose from eight world warriors and battle your way to the championship. Revolutionary fighting game that defined the genre.

game.name: Q*bert
game.desc: Hop around a pyramid of cubes changing their colors while avoiding enemies. Unique isometric perspective for its era.

game.name: Ms. Pac-Man
game.desc: The sequel to Pac-Man featuring new maze designs and improved gameplay. Widely considered superior to the original.
